summary: Learn to map contract permissions, govern upgrades, and document on-chain controls. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Smart contract governance training helps blockchain product owners, developers, and security or governance leads manage permissions, upgrades, and approval processes. It covers mapping privileged roles, designing upgrade approvals, assessing multisignature and timelock controls, and keeping governance records that connect on-chain activity with accountable operating roles.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape or operate smart contract permissions, upgrades, treasury actions, and governance processes. It is designed for roles that need to connect Solidity-level controls with practical approval and accountability procedures.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with blockchain concepts, smart contract use, or blockchain operations is expected. Coding is not required for course completion; exercises focus on reading contract-control examples and producing governance artefacts.
